setup.heading: Connect your notes
setup.configure: Set your Nodus server address in plugin settings first.
setup.web: Create a short-lived pairing code in Nodus Web, then select Pair device below.
setup.terminal: A terminal opens automatically. The code is visible as you type; lowercase letters are converted to uppercase.
setup.finish: Notes load automatically after pairing. If an attempt has an unknown outcome, use Pair device again with the same server to retry it.
setup.paired: This device is already paired. Changing the server setting does not replace its credential or move its notes.
setup.enter_code: Enter the pairing code in the terminal that just opened.
setup.terminal_close: Press Enter to close this terminal.
setup.no_terminal: Could not open a terminal. Configure a terminal in Noctalia, then try Pair device again.

instance_url.label: Nodus server
instance_url.description: HTTPS origin, e.g. https://nodus.example.com. Used for first pairing; changing this does not replace an existing pairing.

status.busy: Nodus is busy; finish pairing if its terminal is open
status.rate_limited: Nodus is busy · waiting before refresh
status.unknown: A write may have reached Nodus
status.conflict: A write needs review in Nodus Web
status.unpaired: Pair this device with Nodus first
